title: Common Irregular Preterites
summary: Learn the most frequent irregular past forms such as fui, tive, fiz, disse, and pude.

sections.heading: High-frequency irregular verbs
sections.body:
Many essential verbs have irregular preterite stems. These forms are common in conversation and storytelling.

| Infinitive | eu | você/ele/ela | nós | eles/elas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ir/ser | fui | foi | fomos | foram |
| ter | tive | teve | tivemos | tiveram |
| fazer | fiz | fez | fizemos | fizeram |
| dizer | disse | disse | dissemos | disseram |

sections.heading: More useful irregulars
sections.body: Other everyday verbs include **estar → estive**, **poder → pude**, **querer → quis**, **saber → soube**, and **vir → vim**. Their meanings can be specific in the preterite.

examples.en: He wanted to talk to you.
I found out the news today.
examples.note: saber in the preterite often means find out

sections.heading: Ser and ir share forms
sections.body: In the preterite, **ser** and **ir** have the same forms. Context tells you whether it means 'was/were' or 'went'.

keyPoints: Irregular preterites must be memorized as whole forms.
Ser and ir are identical in the preterite: fui, foi, fomos, foram.
Saber in the preterite often means 'found out'.
Poder in the preterite often means 'managed/could in that situation'.

commonMistakes.note: Temporary state in the past uses estar: esteve.
For destination, use para/a, not em.
